name: Learn Coding in Space
tagline: Blast off and learn Python among the stars with Astro, Comet and Nova.
description: Astro the astronaut, Comet the rocket and Nova the planet turn every lesson into a space mission.
features: Space lessons: countdowns, planets and more

lessons.name: HELLO, SPACE
lessons.title: 👋 HELLO, SPACE
lessons.subtitle: Send your first message to the stars! 🚀

examples.label: 1️⃣ Say hello 🚀
examples.explain: print() shows a message on the screen. The words go inside quotes.

examples.label: 2️⃣ The crew 🧑‍🚀
examples.explain: Each print() starts a new line, so the crew says hello one by one.
examples.output:
🧑‍🚀 Astro is ready.
☄️ Comet is ready.
🪐 Nova is ready.
Let's fly!

lessons.name: COUNTDOWN
lessons.title: ⏱️ COUNTDOWN
lessons.subtitle: Loops count down so the rocket can launch! 🔥

examples.explain: range(5, 0, -1) counts 5, 4, 3, 2, 1. The for loop runs print() once for each number.

examples.label: 2️⃣ Use up the fuel ⛽
examples.explain: A while loop repeats while something is true. Here it stops when the fuel reaches 0.
examples.output:
Fuel left: 3
Fuel left: 2
Fuel left: 1
Time to land! 🌕

lessons.name: PLANET LISTS
lessons.title: 🪐 PLANET LISTS
lessons.subtitle: Keep all the planets in one list! 📋

examples.label: 1️⃣ Visit each planet 🪐
examples.explain: A list keeps many things in order. The for loop visits each planet in the list.
examples.output:
Visiting Mercury 🪐
Visiting Venus 🪐
Visiting Earth 🪐
Visiting Mars 🪐

examples.label: 2️⃣ Add a planet ➕
examples.explain: append() adds to the end of the list, len() counts the list, and [-1] is the last one.
examples.output:
We know 5 planets now!
The biggest is Jupiter
